Soar High with the Indian Air Force: Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 Recruitment 2026 is LIVE!

Are you ready to embark on a thrilling journey of patriotism, discipline, and unparalleled service to the nation? The Indian Air Force (IAF) has officially announced the recruitment for Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 under the transformative Agnipath Scheme! This is a golden opportunity for unmarried Indian male and female candidates to join the elite ranks of the IAF and contribute to national security. The online application window is currently open, so aspiring Agniveers, it's time to prepare for take-off!

Important Dates to Remember

Mark your calendars! The application process is swift, and you wouldn't want to miss these critical deadlines.

Event Date
Application Begin July 6, 2026
Last Date for Apply Online July 26, 2026 (11:00 PM)
Last Date to Pay Fees July 26, 2026
Online Exam Dates September 22-23, 2026
Eligibility Criteria: Are You Ready to Serve?

Before you hit that apply button, ensure you meet the essential eligibility requirements set by the Indian Air Force. The Agnipath Scheme invites young, dynamic individuals to join.

1. Age Limit
Candidates must be born between July 1, 2005, and January 1, 2010 (both dates inclusive). This translates to a minimum age of 17.5 years and a maximum of 21-22 years at the time of enrollment, adhering to the scheme's guidelines. Only unmarried male and female candidates are eligible to apply.
2. Educational Qualifications
The educational requirements vary based on the subject stream.

For Science Subjects:

✅ Passed Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent examination with Mathematics, Physics, and English, securing a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.

✅ OR, possess a 3-year Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/Information Technology) with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English in the Diploma Course.

✅ OR, have completed a 2-year Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects Physics and Math from a recognized board, with 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English.

For Other Than Science Subjects:

✅ Passed Intermediate (10+2) or an equivalent examination in any stream/subjects with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English.

✅ OR, completed a 2-year Vocational Course with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English.

3. Medical Standards
Aspirants must meet specified physical and medical standards. Key requirements include a minimum height of 152.5 cm (for both male and female candidates) and a chest expansion of 5 cm. Candidates must have normal hearing and anatomy, free from any active or latent, acute or chronic medical or surgical incapacity, infection, or skin disorders.
The Application Process: Your Gateway to the IAF

Applying for the Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 is a streamlined online process. Follow these steps carefully to ensure a successful submission:

1. Visit the Official Portal
Navigate to the official Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu recruitment portal: agnipathvayu.cdac.in or iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
2. Register and Log In
Register using a valid email ID and mobile number. After verification via OTP, you will receive your User ID and Password. Log in with these credentials.
3. Fill the Application Form
Carefully fill in all personal, educational, and communication details as required.
4. Upload Documents
Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size color photograph (10 KB to 50 KB, taken with a black slate showing your name and date), signature, left thumb impression (if applicable), Class 10th and 12th marksheets/certificates (or diploma), Aadhaar Card, and any other specified documents.
5. Pay Application Fee
The application fee is Rs. 550 + GST, payable online via credit card/debit card or UPI.
6. Review and Submit
Cross-check all the details in your application form before final submission. Download and print a copy for your records.

The IAF strongly advises candidates to apply well before the deadline of July 26, 2026, to avoid any last-minute technical glitches. No extension of the application window will be granted.

The Selection Process: A Multi-Stage Journey

The path to becoming an Agniveer Vayu involves a rigorous, multi-stage selection process designed to identify the most capable individuals.

Phase 1: Online Test
This is a computer-based multiple-choice test. Questions will be bilingual (English & Hindi) except for the English paper.
  • For Science Subjects: 60 minutes, covering English, Physics, and Mathematics (based on the 10+2 CBSE syllabus).
  • For Other Than Science Subjects: 45 minutes, covering Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA) and English (based on the 10+2 CBSE syllabus).
Phase 2: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Tests, and Document Verification
Candidates who clear the online test will proceed to Phase 2. This includes a Physical Fitness Test, followed by Adaptability Test-I and Adaptability Test-II, and thorough Document Verification.
Phase 3: Medical Examination
The final stage involves a comprehensive medical examination covering various tests, including blood hemogram, urine analysis, and biochemistry tests, to ensure candidates meet all IAF medical standards.
Benefits of Serving as an Agniveer under the Agnipath Scheme

The Agnipath Scheme offers a unique opportunity with several benefits for those who join the Indian Air Force as Agniveers:

✅ Four-Year Tenure: Serve the nation for a period of four years.

✅ Attractive Monthly Salary: Start with ₹30,000 per month, with annual increments.

✅ Seva Nidhi Package: A substantial one-time lump sum (approx. ₹11.71 Lakhs, including interest) upon completion of the four-year engagement, comprising your contribution and a matching contribution from the government.

✅ Life Insurance Cover: Non-contributory Life Insurance Cover of ₹48 Lakhs for the duration of engagement.

✅ Skill Certificate: Receive a detailed skill-set certificate at the end of your tenure, highlighting acquired skills and competencies, enhancing future employment prospects.

✅ Annual and Sick Leave: Enjoy 30 days of annual leave and sick leave based on medical advice.

✅ Opportunity for Permanent Enrolment: Up to 25% of Agniveers may be selected for permanent enrolment in the Indian Air Force based on organizational requirements and performance during their four-year service.

✅ Reservations: Ex-Agniveers will receive a 10% reservation in recruitment in Assam Rifles and CAPFs.

This is a call to all spirited young individuals who dream of wearing the uniform and serving the nation with pride. The Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 is your chance to turn that dream into reality. Don't delay, apply now and take the first step towards an honorable and rewarding career!
